_about: John Tyndall (1820-1893), physicist, on the philosophy of science: Fragments of Science, sixth edition, 2 vols. in one (London: Longmans, Green, 1879); Essays on the Use and Limit of the Imagination in Science (London: Longmans, Green, 1870); the Belfast Address to the British Association (London: Longmans, Green, 1874). Clean Gutenberg texts. His physics popularisations (Light, Sound, Heat, the glaciers) are not taken. US public domain. No uids minted.
